# Files that CI builds or runs but that do not change the shipped binary: a
# change to them is tested but, once releases are tagged from main, makes no
# release by itself.
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.

# line endings at checkout, which the tests can see
.gitattributes
# CI's workflows, lists and scripts, and the release notes' sections
.github/*
# the generator of the npr7150.2d template's requirements: tested, not shipped (what it writes is, in templates/)
tools/npr7150/*
# the PDF reader that took the text of standards into the templates: tested, not shipped
tools/pdf/*
# the script that takes mermaid.js into vendor/ (which is shipped)
tools/mermaid/*
# the generator of a large project for timing skein: run by hand, not shipped
tools/bench/*
